paper_title: New CAST Limit on the Axion-Photon Interaction
notes: CAST helioscope solar axion search (2013-2015 vacuum phase). World-leading limit g_agamma < 0.66e-10 GeV^-1 at 95% C.L. for m_a <= 0.02 eV.
